correctness.rationale: The exact reflection halfspace test yields 16 simultaneous switched-pentagon inequalities; summation proves s>=5, and Walsh orthogonality pins every K5 coordinate. Published Theorem 3.3 supplies a complete facet list for maximal K3,3-minor-free graphs. At the half center all pentagons have reflection ratio 5 and all triangles ratio 3, proving the upper bound. Coordinate projection gives arbitrary-graph extension and K5 pinning. Triangle inequalities retain exact 1/6 slack in every non-K5 direction, proving the complete maximal-graph center-locus dimension. The rational script validates all critical finite support and orthogonality identities, plus two exact centers of a 12-edge example.

value.rationale: An explicit affine-invariant geometry theorem for an infinite forbidden-minor class beyond edge transitivity: asymmetry stays exactly five under arbitrary K3,3-minor-free extensions retaining K5, but optimal-center spaces vary from a point to arbitrarily high dimension. The full facet halfspace and uniqueness/dimension criteria reveal structural interaction of pentagon rigidity with triangle slack. This is not mere recomputation of the previously known K5 base case.
